subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should the remaining Talk/Voice selector work land Android-first using existing gateway agent/session state, or wait for a shared Android/iOS/macOS Talk UX decision?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested behavior affects user-visible session state and spans multiple companion-app surfaces, so automation should not choose the platform scope or permanent UX model.

options.title: Android-first Talk selector
options.body: Implement the Android Voice/Talk selector first, wire it to existing gateway agent/session state, and validate real multi-agent Talk routing before expanding to other companion apps.

options.title: Shared native Talk design
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers choose one common Talk/Voice selector model for Android, iOS, and macOS.

options.title: Defer behind Chat selector
options.body: Wait until the Android Chat selector PR is repaired or closed, then reuse any accepted selected-agent state model for Talk/Voice.

recommendation.title: Android-first Talk selector
recommendation.body: Implement the Android Voice/Talk selector first, wire it to existing gateway agent/session state, and validate real multi-agent Talk routing before expanding to other companion apps.

likelyOwner.reason: This person already scoped the completed TTS half versus the remaining Talk/Voice selector work and owns much of the landed TTS config path history.
